debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for log messages (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

log_file.description: Absolute path to the main log file. Leave empty to log only to stdout/stderr.

database.description: SQLite file path (if backend=sqlite) or PostgreSQL connection URI (if backend=postgresql).

api_host.description: Network interface (IP or hostname) the REST API listens on.

api_port.description: Port number for the Cumin REST API endpoint.

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate for HTTPS. Leave blank to use HTTP only.

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key matching the certificate above.

max_requests.description: Maximum concurrent API requests. 0 means unlimited.

command_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before aborting a remote command.

discovery_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before aborting target discovery (e.g., DNS resolution).

allow_shell.description: If true, allows arbitrary shell commands in targets. Not recommended in multi-tenant or untrusted environments.

auth_config.description: Path to auth backend config (e.g., /etc/cumin/ldap.conf or /etc/cumin/local_users.yaml).

ssh_user.description: Default remote user for SSH connections to targets.

ssh_key.description: Path to SSH private key used for authentication (if not using agent/password).

ssh_workers.description: Number of parallel SSH workers. Increase for large target sets.

ssh_reuse.description: Enable SSH connection reuse to reduce latency and overhead.

target_groups.description: Security groups defining allowed target sets and descriptions.

name.description: Unique group name (used in target matching).

description.description: Human-readable description of the group's purpose.

command_rules.description: Permission rules mapping groups to allowed command patterns.

group.description: Name of the target group this rule applies to.

commands.description: List of allowed command patterns or regexes (e.g., 'ping', 'uptime', '^df$').

audit_enabled.description: Enable detailed audit logging of user actions.

audit_log.description: File path for audit logs (requires write permissions).

async_timeout.description: Max time (seconds) an async job may remain pending before timeout.

max_async_jobs.description: Maximum number of pending async jobs queued at once.
